things.note: A plain circle labelled WHEEL; no tyre, spokes or car.
Only the text 'TWO TONS' beside the wheel circle.
A box labelled BRAKE FLUID; no cylinder or liquid drawn.
A small box labelled BRAKE LINE; no tube.
Only the word PISTONS beside the caliper box.
Two small rounded rectangles labelled PAD, side by side above the disc.
The wheel circle is relabelled DISC; a plain circle that does not spin.
Only the text CAR'S MOTION beside the disc.
The disc circle fills salmon-pink with the word HEAT; colour suggests heat but only by convention and label.

changes.change: foot pushes the pedal about five centimeters
changes.note: A '5 CM' tag appears beside the pedal box; the box does not move.

changes.change: pedal pushes a piston into the cylinder
changes.note: A PISTON box and a small arrow with 'PUSH' appear; nothing moves in.

changes.change: pressure travels down the lines to the wheel
changes.note: Labelled boxes and 'PRESSURE' tags are added one after another; nothing flows.
Only the words 'CAN'T BE SQUEEZED' appear.

changes.change: caliper pistons squeeze two pads against the disc
changes.note: The pads appear but stay apart and never move to touch the disc.
The disc circle recolours from plain to pink, though the friction itself is not drawn.

changes.change: the disc glows after a hard stop
changes.note: Disc stays pink; a colour change only, no glow effect.
